In the plastic strengthening stage, all three kinds of alloys have obvious work hardening phenomenon.
With the increasing of impact bar speed, the ultimate strength of TiZrHfAl 0.3 and TiZrHfCu0.3 specimens increases signi ﬁcantly. The two alloys show a certain strain rate effect.
From a microscopic point of view, the added trace element Cu promotes the bonding strength between the original atoms.

In the plastic strengthening stage, all three kinds of alloys have obvious work hardening phenomenon. According to the stress – strain curves obtained from the experiment, the strengthening phenomenon of TiZrHfCu 0.3 is the most signi ﬁcant.
With the increasing of impact bar speed, the ultimate strength of TiZrHfAl 0.3 and TiZrHfCu0.3 specimens increases signi ﬁcantly. The two alloys show a certain strain rate effect.
From a microscopic point of view, the added trace element Cu promotes the bonding strength between the original atoms.

It can be seen that the slope of the linear elastic stage is TiZrHfCu 0.3 > TiZrHfAl0.3 > TiZrHfNi0.3, which indicates that TiZrHfCu 0.3 has the largest elastic modulus and the strongest deformation resistance, followed by TiZrHfAl 0.3 and TiZrHfNi0.3.
